SQLite public-domain notice

SQLite's deliverable code and documentation have been dedicated to the public
domain by their authors. SQLite does not require a license for their use,
modification or distribution.

Official statement: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

Sotto includes SQLite as part of SQLCipher, rather than as a separate bundled
SQLite library. SQLCipher's additions are separately licensed; their copyright,
conditions and disclaimer are retained in SQLCipher-LICENSE.txt.
